svg.title: How we implement Stage 3: the OMA LwM2M example
svg.desc: Stage 3 for OMA LwM2M and Public Lighting. It takes a spec per property from Stage 2, plus the entity sketch and the city's questions, asks every ecosystem the same questions, and checks OMA in two ways: every data point in the registry (draft) and every capability. The output is an assessment report for Stage 4 with recommendations to the OMA SmartCities Working Group. Public Lighting result: 6 capabilities covered today, 6 partly covered, 1 needs a new OMA capability, 1 belongs to other systems. Where we are: done, open questions on the draft classification, and next steps: SIG review, propose three shared labels to OMA, and find Smart Data Models that fit the entity sketch.

OMA lighting devices already report most of what the city needs. What is missing is a few shared labels:
which asset or spot was measured, how the value was obtained (measured or estimated), and over what time period.
Smart Cities SIG working analysis, October 2026. A covers the whole OMA LwM2M Registry (draft classification); B covers Public Lighting.
